records.title: The latest iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods lineups arrive in stores worldwide
records.text: On Friday, September 18, Apple Store locations around the world introduced customers to the iPhone 18 Pro lineup, Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and AirPods 5.

records.title: Widow’s Bay triumphs as most decorated freshman comedy in Emmy history
records.text: This evening at the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards, Apple TV shatters records to become the most-awarded network of the year, landing 29 wins overall.
